items.title: Bob Wilber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: returned the horn to my student and said, “Thank you, Nick, and I hope I never have to play the C melody saxophone again.”

ctx.x: Yeah, Lester Young too. Then after I did the movie, I returned the horn to my student and said, “Thank you, Nick, and I hope I never have to play the C melody saxophone again.”
